session.scenario: Generate a suite of 3 to 5 distinct pytest tests for the selected public Python functions using the FULL source module context. Cover every selected function at least once. Preserve helper calls and constants in the original module; never copy production functions into tests. Each test must exercise a meaningful different example grounded in the user's expected behavior. Include normal and boundary cases within the documented valid inputs. Do not invent negative, null or unsupported inputs. Give each test a unique descriptive name. The names in tests[] must exactly match the functions in test_code. Import selected functions using from pricing import FUNCTION_NAME. Use separate def test_NAME() functions with no parameters, decorators, fixtures or parametrization. Use plain assert statements. Do not change the expected result to match a bug in the code. Copy exact expected values supplied by the user verbatim, including rounding expectations. Use only Python standard library and pytest.

tests.name: test_price_twenty_percent
tests.scenario: Tests price_after_discount with a standard 20% discount.

tests.name: test_price_zero_percent
tests.scenario: Tests price_after_discount when the discount percentage is 0% (boundary case).

tests.name: test_price_full_discount
tests.scenario: Tests price_after_discount when the discount percentage is 100% (boundary case).

tests.name: test_amount_twenty_percent
tests.scenario: Tests discount_amount calculation for a 20% discount.

tests.name: test_amount_rounding
tests.scenario: Tests discount_amount calculation where rounding down occurs in price_after_discount.

session.expected: Both functions accept integer price_cents >= 0 and integer percent in [0,100]. price_after_discount subtracts the percentage discount and rounds down to whole cents; discount_amount returns original price minus that discounted price. Generate exactly five tests with these UNIQUE names and exact assertions: test_price_twenty_percent: price_after_discount(10000,20)==8000; test_price_zero_percent: price_after_discount(10000,0)==10000; test_price_full_discount: price_after_discount(10000,100)==0; test_amount_twenty_percent: discount_amount(10000,20)==2000; test_amount_rounding: discount_amount(3333,10)==334. Copy the exact expected integers; 334 is intentional because 3333 minus floor(3333*90/100) is 334.
